run_image_qa_single: run a single image question-asking request with an image path and question using image_qa
run_image_qa_stream: run an image question-asking request with streaming output enabled for incremental token display
run_image_qa_batch: run multiple image question-asking requests in a batch with different image paths and questions
create_sgl_runtime: create an sgl.Runtime backend instance with a model path for local LLaVA inference
get_chat_template: get a chat template for llama-3-instruct-llava to configure the runtime endpoint
